hook.text: More text is produced every day on screens than was written in all centuries combined before the internet.

buildup.text: Digital technology has transformed how writing is produced, distributed, and consumed.

discovery.text: Unicode now encodes over 150,000 characters from 161 scripts—making digital multilingualism possible.

twist.text: Keyboards and autocorrect shape what we write—technology isn't neutral; it influences language.

climax.text: Digital writing blurs the line between writing and speech—texts and chats feel more spoken than written.

punchline.text: The screen is the new page—and it's rewriting the rules.

quiz.question: What does Unicode enable?
options: Encoding characters from virtually all scripts digitally
